Answer: B
Reason: The sagittal and axial CT images demonstrate a focal outpouching with irregular contours at the aortic isthmus (just distal to the left subclavian artery origin), which is characteristic of a traumatic pseudoaneurysm resulting from blunt deceleration injury. This vascular lesion creates the appearance of mediastinal widening, whereas the other options do not match the specific focal aortic pathology shown.
